title: Preserve trace randomness independently of recording
goal: Preserve trace randomness metadata while forwarding activity context or changing recording decisions; distinguish inherited flags, default roots and custom generators.

constraints: RandomTraceId describes generation metadata independently of Recorded; do not infer random quality from a small sample.
